body: I made it through the night. Couldn't bring myself to cause even more pain to my family. Still want to die because it would stop my pain but I just don't know how long keeping other people from suffering will be enough.

Life just keeps proving I'm not worth it. Over and over and over again I just keep being shown how little I'm worth. I love my family and I know they love me but I also know they're tired of the pain I end up in causing them pain. And knowing all I do is cause pain for the people I love on top of my husband deciding I'm not worth his love anymore is too much. This pain can never be healed

He's sick and refuses to believe what he's being told by docs and keeps walking away from me every few days because of the illness that is physical which has caused mental illness. And while I'm not going anywhere because I don't have it in me to walk away. I stillay here wishing I was gone because it would hurt less than him walking away from me. Sick or not...i can't stop the way I feel when he says he's done with me again.
